statement: Adding the subgroup feature x([n/q]Q) lets gradient boosting recover (+-k* mod q) mod 2 with accuracy 1.000 on 20/20 smooth 40-bit curves (z +48..+55), while default features (bits of x, x mod m, Legendre, x/p) stay at chance on every class; the earlier null is bounded to that default feature family.
